name: CLIENT-FUNDED PRODUCTION (internal shorthand: BYOP — Bring Your Own Provider)

fields.funding_mode: SITE00_INCLUDED | CLIENT_REIMBURSED | CLIENT_FUNDED_PROVIDER | CLIENT_PREPAID_PRODUCTION_WALLET | WAIVED_LABOR_CLIENT_FUNDS_EXPENSES | CUSTOM

modes.SITE00_INCLUDED: Production expenses are inside the service price; client sees ledger as "INCLUDED".
modes.CLIENT_REIMBURSED: SITE 00 spends on its own provider account; client reimburses per family (invoice line). Requires founder-approved estimate before family starts.
modes.CLIENT_FUNDED_PROVIDER: Client owns the provider account/credits; SITE 00 uses it only for that project under explicit authorization.
modes.CLIENT_PREPAID_PRODUCTION_WALLET: Client prepays a production balance held by SITE 00; ledger draws it down. Requires payments rails (deferred).
modes.WAIVED_LABOR_CLIENT_FUNDS_EXPENSES: Labor waived (e.g. family relationship); client funds third-party expenses via one of the above mechanisms.

now (with MVP): manual-attested funding confirmation for CLIENT_FUNDED_PROVIDER / CLIENT_REIMBURSED
